build_distributed_impala_program: build a distributed IMPALA agent topology using DistributedIMPALA.build with environment and network factories
create_impala_learner: create an IMPALA learner process with a Reverb dataset and Sonnet network for training
create_impala_actor: create an IMPALA actor process that interacts with the environment and adds sequences to replay
create_replay_queue: create a Reverb queue table with sequence signatures for the IMPALA replay buffer
create_impala_evaluator: create an IMPALA evaluator process that evaluates the policy using the latest network variables
